A13Analogue

Precision Adder

Add pitch voltages precisely

Adds up to four voltages precisely and outputs the sum both normal and inverted. Made for pitch: sequencer plus octave plus transposition lands exactly on the right note.

  • 0.02 % precision resistors
  • Octave switch and octave CV
  • OFFSET control
